entry.title: googleapis/google-cloud-dotnet - Releases - 2026-09-01
entry.content:
Google.Cloud.AppTopology.V1 version 1.0.0-beta01

New features

  • Initial generation for Google.Cloud.AppTopology.V1

Google.Cloud.GeminiDataAnalytics.V1 version 1.1.0

New features

  • Add a new field property_graph_references to support BigQuery graphs in the Gemini Data Analytics API

Google.Cloud.GeminiDataAnalytics.V1Beta version 1.0.0-beta11

New features

  • Update v1beta protos for datasources and query data response

Documentation improvements

  • Update comment for total_row_count in ExecutedQueryResult

Google.Cloud.Spanner version 5.13.0-beta10

New features

  • Standardize Protobuf Message and Enum naming conventions
  • Refactor SpannerDbType to use ForX methods for protobuf initialization

Google.Maps.Routing.V2 version 1.3.0

New features

  • Publish tunnel, bridge, and skyway fields in Routes API v2
  • Add US_MI_BREAKAWAY toll pass to Routes API v2

Documentation improvements

  • A comment for enum ExtraComputation is changed
  • A comment for enum value HTML_FORMATTED_NAVIGATION_INSTRUCTIONS in enum ExtraComputation is changed
  • A comment for enum value FLYOVER_INFO_ON_POLYLINE in enum ExtraComputation is changed
  • A comment for enum value NARROW_ROAD_INFO_ON_POLYLINE in enum ExtraComputation is changed
  • A comment for field optimize_waypoint_order in message .google.maps.routing.v2.ComputeRoutesRequest is changed
  • A comment for field navigation_point_token in message .google.maps.routing.v2.Waypoint is changed

Google.Cloud.Dlp.V2 version 4.27.0

New features

  • Add ContentPolicy configuration and management APIs
  • Add FileLabelInfoType to CustomInfoType for detecting Microsoft Sensitivity Labels and Google Drive Labels

Documentation improvements

  • Update documentation links

Google.Cloud.Compute.V1 version 3.31.0

New features

  • Update Compute Engine v1 API artifacts to revision 20260807
  • Add FutureReservationStoragePoolProvisionedCapacity message definition
  • Add requested_storage_pool_provisioned_capacity and storage_pool_type fields to FutureReservation
  • Add min_cpu_platform field to InstanceSelection
  • Add RegexRewrite message definition
  • Add regex_rewrite field to UrlRewrite
  • Add ResourceMetadata message definition
  • Add resource_metadata field to Allocation
  • Add ASN key type to security policy fingerprint

Documentation improvements

  • Update documentation in proto definitions

Google.Cloud.BigQuery.Reservation.V1 version 2.14.0

New features

  • Add new AUTOMATIC_MATERIALIZED_VIEW_REFRESH reservation assignment job type
  • Allow for reservation groups to be updated and expose new parent_group, creation_time, and update_time fields on the group resource

Documentation improvements

  • Mark FLEX commitment plan for capacity commitments as deprecated
  • A comment for field principal in message .google.cloud.bigquery.reservation.v1.Assignment is changed

Google.Cloud.BigQuery.Migration.V2 version 1.8.0

New features

  • Promote lineage outputs to v2

Google.Cloud.Batch.V1 version 2.16.0

New features

  • Added new NicType field to job

Documentation improvements

  • Restrict allowed_locations region or zone values to the same region where the job is created
